reviews.comment: Took his modern rhetorical theory class, he is super knowledgeable about the material. Its less of like "oh crap whats on the test" and more of genuine learning experience where we discuss as a class and truly dive deep. Exams and papers are not difficult, just don't miss his lectures. But his lectures are really entertaining and go by quickly.

Professor Pilsch was one of the best profs I've ever taken at A&M, he is so caring and willing to help you with anything! He gives interesting lectures and he gives really creative assignments! I recommend him 100%, take him if you get the chance to!
Dr. Pilsch is a very understanding and passionate professor. If you get a chance to take him, jump at it.

Pilsch's 334 class ruled. The entire grade was on 4 papers. His late policy was incredibly fair, and he would give extensions if you needed them. I would love to take another class from him again and would recommend his class to anyone who needs an English credit. Get ready to read some books for the papers you have to write, but it's reasonable.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Pilsch is very caring and is there to help in any way he can. He grades fairly easily and will allow a rewrite for the first paper so you know what he expects come future essays. He's super insightful about the topics and quick to respond to emails with any questions you have. I recommend him for an easy writing class!
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof Pilsch is super chill; he is very knowledgeable on what he is teaching and I have learned a lot from this class! typical workload for upper level english course, but he is flexible with deadlines and wants his students to succeed. He is very accessible outside of class, and always lets you know exactly what he expects to get a good grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Hands down one of my favorite classes! Professor Pilsch is caring and willing to accommodate student needs. There are three papers, none of which are extremely difficult to compose. The reading for our course (Science Fiction) was thought provoking as well as good- I genuinely wanted to finish each piece! Amazing prof 11/10
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Pilsch is very understanding and is very clearly knowledgeable and passionate about what he teaches. Deadlines are given, but simply ask for an extension and he's more likely than not to be accommodating and let you take the time you need to turn in your paper.

Really great professor! He is very understanding, gives extensions, clearly cares about what students have to say, and gives very simple and straightforward exams. I would especially recommend this professor if you're a non-english major who needs a literature class for your degree, he makes it very easy and interesting.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Pilsch gets excited about the material and genuinely enjoys discussions with students. He cares about his students (he got mad when he found out one of the mandatory books was available for free online because we all bought it). He asked cares about the quality of the writing assignments and is willing to give extensions. Hes just a cool dude!
Dr. Pilsch is an amazing prof! He's really into the lectures and he's great at explaining the material. I've taken two classes with him, and I would recommend him to anyone thinking of taking him.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Pilsch was honestly one of the best professors Ive had at TAMU, he genuinely cares about his students, and the class was small enough for him to know everyone by name. Hes really funny, and made class interesting every time. I loved having him as my professor, and I will very gladly take him for my senior seminar professor as well

This professor was fantastic, as was his re-construction of this course. He's very friendly and funny, clearly extremely intelligent, and cares way more about you actually learning things than whether you get the assignment in by 11:59pm or follow the syllabus like a religious text. This is how education should be.

I have taken three classes with Dr. Pilsch and would continue to take more if I could! Very interesting and fair teacher, and his classes are always fun! (Especially English 460). Definitely recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Hilarious--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Pilsch is very passionate about what he teaches, and he is funny. The class consisted of 3 papers, and a participation grade. There is a reading every day. You only need to buy 2 of the books, since most of the readings are online. He's very lenient on deadlines, and accesible outside of class. Great prof. would recommend.
